test_name: System and Services Acquisition - SA-3 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Claims-Processing-164
Primary NIST family: System and Services Acquisition (SA); evidence focus: SA-3.
Environment: AWS GovCloud. Network access uses PrivateLink; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: security and privacy requirements are integrated throughout the system development life cycle. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
